title: Running Commentary on Torah 8 — Menoras Zahav - I Saw a Golden Menorah
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 8 — ראיתי והנה מנורת זהב
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: Torah 8 opens with the pasuk: **"Ra'isi v'hineh **menoras zahav kulah**, v'gulah al rosha"** — 'I saw, and behold, a menorah all of gold, with a bowl on top of it' (Zechariah 4:2), **"which is the Haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah."** The Rebbe signals upfront: this is a Chanukah Torah. Every detail he teaches — the krechtz of a Jew, the ruach chayim that completes every lack, the tzaddik who draws that ruach from Torah, the rav-of-the-klipah who draws opposing ruach, the tzitzis with its four corners corresponding to the four winds — all of it is the structure of the golden menorah and why Zechariah saw it specifically at the moment of re-consecration.

intermediate.en: Base pasuk: **"Ra'isi v'hineh menoras zahav kulah v'gulah al rosha"** (Zechariah 4:2) — **Haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah**. The entire Torah will decode the vision: krechtz of a Jew, ruach chayim via tzaddik, rav-of-klipah, tzitzis-as-four-winds, Menachos-mei-midbar — all mapped to the golden menorah with its bowl-on-top.
intermediate.he: פסוק־יסוד: **"רָאִיתִי וְהִנֵּה מְנוֹרַת זָהָב כֻּלָּהּ וְגֻלָּה עַל רֹאשָׁהּ"** (זכריה ד, ב) — **הפטרת שבת חנוכה**. כל התורה תפענח את המראה: קרעכץ של יהודי, רוח חיים מהצדיק, רב דקליפה, ציצית־ארבע־רוחות, מתי מדבר — הכל ממופה על המנורה הזהב עם גולתה.

scholarly.he: פסוק היסוד: "ראיתי והנה מנורת זהב כולה וגולה על ראשה" (זכריה ד, ב — הפטרת שבת חנוכה).

beginner.en: The opening teaching — a beloved sentence. **"Behold, precious is the **g'nuchi v'nahi** (groaning and moaning — what they call a **krechtz**) of a Jew, because it is the **shleimus ha'chesronos** (completion of every lack)."** Why is a sigh so valuable? **"By the aspect of the **neshimah** (breath), which is the **ruach ha'chayim** (spirit of life), the world was created — as it is written: **'u'b'ruach piv kol tzva'am'** (Tehillim 33:6). And the renewal of the world will be in the aspect of the ruach, as it is written: **'tishlach ruchacha yiba're'un u'sechadesh pnei adamah'** (Tehillim 104:30)."** And personally: **"This is also man's life, because his life is the neshimah — **'vayipach b'apav nishmas chayim'** (Bereshis 2:7); **'kol asher nishmas ruach chayim b'apav'** (Bereshis 7:22)."** As Chazal said: **"'If the breath is lacking — life is lacking.'"** **Therefore the essence of the chayus of every thing is in the aspect of **ruach** — and when there is a lack in any thing, it is a lack in the **ruach chayim**.** A krechtz *draws* ruach chayim into the exact place the lack lives.

intermediate.en: Opening: **"Yakar g'nuchi v'nahi (krechtz) of a Jew = shleimus ha'chesronos (completion of every lack)."** The **neshimah = ruach chayim** created and renews the world ("u'b'ruach piv," Teh 33:6; "tishlach ruchacha yiba're'un," Teh 104:30). Life itself = breath ("vayipach b'apav," Ber 2:7; "kol asher nishmas ruach chayim," Ber 7:22). **Every lack is a lack in ruach chayim** — the krechtz draws ruach directly into the gap.
intermediate.he: פתיחה: **"יקר גנוחי ונהי (קרעכץ) של יהודי = שלמות החסרונות."** ה**נשימה = רוח החיים** בה נברא ויתחדש העולם ("וברוח פיו", תה' לג, ו; "תשלח רוחך", תה' קד, ל). החיות עצמה = נשימה ("ויפח באפיו", בר' ב, ז; "כל אשר נשמת רוח חיים", בר' ז, כב). **כל חיסרון = חיסרון רוח החיים** — הקרעכץ ממשיך רוח ישירות לתוך הפרצה.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. "יקר גנוחי ונהי" (קרעכץ) = שלמות החסרונות. נשימה=רוח חיים (תה' לג, ו; קד, ל; בר' ב, ז; ז, כב). כל חסרון — חסרון רוח חיים.

beginner.en: **"But from where do we receive the ruach chayim?"** The Rebbe answers precisely: **"Know, that the essence of ruach chayim is received from the **tzaddik** and the **rav** of the generation — because the essence of ruach chayim is in the **Torah** — as it is written: **'v'ruach Elokim merachefes al pnei ha'mayim'** (Bereshis 1:2) — this is the Torah — and the tzaddikim are attached to Torah, therefore the essence of ruach chayim is with them."** The mechanism: **"When [a person] is connected to the tzaddik and rav of the generation, when he sighs and extends his breath, he draws the ruach chayim from the tzaddik of the generation, who is attached to the Torah, which is where the ruach is."** And therefore the Tanakh's technical term for a true leader: **"'Ish asher ruach bo'** (Bamidbar 27:18) — 'a man in whom is the spirit' — 'who knows to go with the spirit of each and every one' (as Rashi explains there). For the tzaddik **draws and completes the ruach chayim of each and every one."**

intermediate.en: **From where do we receive ruach chayim?** **From the tzaddik/rav of the generation** — because the essence of ruach chayim is in the Torah ("v'ruach Elokim merachefes al pnei ha'mayim," Ber 1:2 = Torah), and tzaddikim are attached to Torah. When you sigh while connected to the tzaddik, you draw ruach chayim from him. Hence the tzaddik is called **"ish asher ruach bo"** (Bam 27:18) — per Rashi: "who knows to go with the spirit of each and every one."
intermediate.he: **מאיפה מקבלים רוח חיים?** **מהצדיק/רב־הדור** — כי עיקר רוח חיים בתורה ("ורוח אלהים מרחפת על פני המים", בר' א, ב = תורה), והצדיקים דבוקים בתורה. כשמתאנח בקישור עם הצדיק, ממשיך ממנו רוח חיים. לכן הצדיק קרוי **"איש אשר רוח בו"** (במ' כז, יח) — לפי רש"י: "שיודע להלך כנגד רוחו של כל אחד ואחד".

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. רוח חיים — מהצדיק ורב הדור, כי עיקרו בתורה (בר' א, ב = תורה). צדיק = "איש אשר רוח בו" (במ' כז, יח; רש"י).

beginner.en: **"But the wicked, who speak against the tzaddik harshly in pride and contempt — from where do *they* receive the ruach to complete their lack?"** The Rebbe's answer is sharp. **"Know, that there is a **rav d'klipah** (rav of the husk), and he is the aspect of **Esav**, as it is written about Esav: **'yesh li rav'** (Bereshis 33:9) — 'I have much/great' — and this is the aspect of **alufei Esav** (the chiefs of Esav, Bereshis 36:15); as Onkelos translates: **'rabrevei Esav'** — 'the great ones of Esav' — the aspect of rav d'klipah."** **"From *them* the wicked receive ruach — and it is **ruach tuma'ah** (impure spirit), aspect of **ruach se'arah** (storm wind) — as it is written: **'hein Esav achi ish **sa'ir**'** (Bereshis 27:11) (see Tikkun 69)."** The precise anatomy of the danger: **"Their ruach is great and powerful **for its moment**, like a storm-wind that is great in its moment. Therefore **'kol tzorerav yafiach bahem'** (Tehillim 10:5) — he blows upon all his adversaries by the aspect of ruach peh of the klipah."**

intermediate.en: **Resha'im receive from the rav d'klipah = Esav.** Proof: "yesh li rav" (Ber 33:9), **alufei Esav** (Ber 36:15), Onkelos's "rabrevei Esav." Their ruach = **ruach tuma'ah, ruach se'arah** ("ish sa'ir," Ber 27:11; Tikkun 69). Critical warning: their ruach is **great for the moment** — like a storm-wind strong in its time — hence **"kol tzorerav yafiach bahem"** (Teh 10:5). A tzaddik-in-the-making who is not yet gamur can be blown over.
intermediate.he: **הרשעים מקבלים מרב דקליפה = עשו.** ראיה: "יש לי רב" (בר' לג, ט), **אלופי עשו** (בר' לו, טו), תרגום "רברבי עשו". רוחם = **רוח טומאה, רוח סערה** ("איש שעיר", בר' כז, יא; תיקון סט). אזהרה: רוחם **גדולה לשעה** — כסערה בזמנה — לכן **"כל צורריו יפיח בהם"** (תה' י, ה). צדיק שאינו גמור עדיין עלול להינפח.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. רב דקליפה = עשו (בר' לג, ט; לו, טו; אונקלוס; תיקון סט). רוח טומאה/רוח סערה — גדול לשעה (תה' י, ה; בר' כז, יא).

beginner.en: **"Therefore: **'v'ish chacham yekaperenah'** (Mishlei 16:14) — 'and a wise man will atone for it' — because the lack is on account of sins — as Chazal said (Shabbos 55a): **'ein misah b'lo chet, v'ein yisurim b'lo avon'** — 'there is no death without sin, no suffering without iniquity' — as it is written: **'u'fakadeti b'shevet pish'am u'binga'im avonam'** (Tehillim 89:33)."** Therefore **"the tzaddik, who draws the ruach chayim and completes the lack, **atones** the sin — and he grows **rachamim and chaninos** (mercies and graces) from the Creator, who contracted Himself to have ruach chayim with the tzaddikim — i.e., they receive the ruach from Torah, and they draw the ruach chayim down to the lacks — and by this they atone the sins. And this is the aspect of the **13 middos** (Shemos 34:6-7): **'Hashem Hashem, El Rachum v'Chanun, erech apayim...'"** The 13 middos are not a recitation-formula; they are *how* the tzaddik draws long, patient ruach (*erech apayim*) into the short, broken breath of a sinner.

intermediate.en: **"V'ish chacham yekaperenah"** (Mishlei 16:14): lack = sin (**"ein misah b'lo chet"** Shab 55a; "u'fakadeti b'shevet pish'am," Teh 89:33). Tzaddik drawing ruach chayim = atoning the sin. He grows rachamim from Hashem who contracted Himself so tzaddikim channel ruach chayim. **13 middos (Shem 34:6-7)** = the mechanism of *long, patient ruach* (erech apayim) flowing into the sinner's short, broken breath.
intermediate.he: **"ואיש חכם יכפרנה"** (מש' טז, יד): חיסרון = חטא (**"אין מיתה בלא חטא"** שבת נה.; "ופקדתי בשבט פשעם", תה' פט, לג). צדיק הממשיך רוח חיים = מכפר החטא. מגדל רחמים מהבורא שצמצם עצמו להעביר רוח דרך הצדיקים. **י"ג מידות (שמ' לד, ו-ז)** = מנגנון *רוח ארוכה סבלנית* (ארך אפיים) הזורמת לנשימה הקצרה והשבורה של החוטא.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. "ואיש חכם יכפרנה" (מש' טז, יד): חסרון מחטא (שבת נה.; תה' פט, לג). הצדיק ממשיך רוח חיים = מכפר; י"ג מידות (שמ' לד, ו-ז) = מנגנון.

beginner.en: **"But to provoke the wicked — it is impossible [for most]"** — because the rasha's ruach, as we saw, is very strong for its moment. **"When [an ordinary Jew] provokes the rasha, and the rasha sighs and draws ruach from his rav of klipah, and that ruach is great at its time — 'kol tzorerav yafiach bahem' — [the rasha] can harm him, chas v'shalom."** **"Therefore, not every person can provoke the wicked — only one who is a **tzaddik gamur** (complete tzaddik). And a tzaddik gamur is when he is in the aspect of **'lo ye'uneh la'tzaddik kol aven'** (Mishlei 12:21) — 'no iniquity befalls the tzaddik' — i.e., he has already driven out and nullified all his own evil, until he is certain that no stumbling of sin will befall him."** Then the kabbalah: **"The matter — because there are four elements: fire, ruach, water, earth — and above, in their root, they are the **four letters of Shem Havayah** which are the root of the **good** of the four elements, as above."**

intermediate.en: **Only a tzaddik gamur can provoke reshaim.** Otherwise the rasha sighs, draws klipah-ruach "great for the moment," and harms. **Tzaddik gamur = "lo ye'uneh la'tzaddik kol aven"** (Mishlei 12:21) — already drove out all own evil. Kabbalah key: four elements (fire, ruach, water, earth) root in **four letters of Shem Havayah** = the **good** of the elements.
intermediate.he: **רק צדיק גמור יכול להתגרות ברשעים.** אחרת הרשע מתאנח, ממשיך רוח־קליפה "גדולה לשעה", ומזיק. **צדיק גמור = "לא יאונה לצדיק כל און"** (מש' יב, כא) — כבר גירש את כל רעו. יסוד הקבלי: ד' יסודות (אש, רוח, מים, עפר) שורשם ב**ד' אותיות שם הוי"ה** = ה**טוב** שביסודות.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. רק צדיק גמור (מש' יב, כא) יכול להתגרות ברשעים. ד' יסודות שורשם בד' אותיות שם הוי"ה.

beginner.en: **"To come to this — to separate, distinguish, and nullify the evil from the good — is by means of **Torah and tefillah**."** The Rebbe is precise about what kind of Torah: **"And the learning of Torah must be **'lalun l'omkah shel halachah'** — to spend the night in the depth of halachah — i.e., to learn poskim."** (see Zohar Behar 111b) Why this specifically? **"For there is in Torah the grasp of good and evil — they grasp from the aspect of **assur v'muttar, tamei v'tahor, kasher u'pasul** — and as long as he does not clarify the halachah he mixes good and evil; therefore he cannot separate the evil from the good, and he is in the aspect of **'v'doresh ra'ah tvo'enu'** (Mishlei 11:27)."** **"Until he delves and clarifies the **psak halachah**, clarifies the **assur u'muttar** — i.e., by learning poskim — then he separates the good from the evil."** Poskim is the *operation* of separation; aggadata alone will not do it.

intermediate.en: **To separate good from evil = Torah + tefillah.** Torah specifically = **"lalun l'omkah shel halachah"** — learning **poskim** (Zohar Behar 111b). Why poskim? Because Torah's grasp of good/evil lives in **assur/muttar, tamei/tahor, kasher/pasul**. Without clarified halachah, good and evil remain mixed, and **"v'doresh ra'ah tvo'enu"** (Mishlei 11:27). Aggadata alone doesn't perform the separation; *psak* does.
intermediate.he: **להפריד טוב מרע = תורה + תפילה.** תורה דווקא = **"ללון לעומקה של הלכה"** — לימוד **פוסקים** (זוהר בהר קיא:). למה פוסקים? כי אחיזת הטוב והרע בתורה באיסור/מותר, טמא/טהור, כשר/פסול. ללא פסק הלכה, טוב ורע מעורבים, ו**"ודורש רעה תבואנו"** (מש' יא, כז). אגדתא לבדה לא מפרידה; *פסק* מפריד.

scholarly.he: סעיף ו. להפריד טוב מרע — תורה (ללון בעומקה של הלכה, זוה"ק בהר קיא.) ותפילה. פוסקים מפרידים טוב מרע (מש' יא, כז).

beginner.en: **"The matter — as written in Tikunei Zohar (tikkun 14, 29b): **'Gan — da oraysa'** — Torah is called **gan** (garden), and the souls of Israel who delve and understand in Torah are the aspect of **grasses and herbs that multiply in the gan**."** Where do the grasses grow from? **"They grow from the **ma'yan** (spring) — this is **chochmah** — as it is written: **'ma'yan ganim'** (Shir HaShirim 4:15) — 'a spring of gardens.'"** And the ma'yan itself? **"From where do they receive the chochmah and intellect — the aspect of the spring? It is from **tefillah** — as it is written: **'u'ma'yan m'beis Hashem yetzei'** (Yoel 4:18) — this is tefillah — as it is written: **'ki beisi beis tefillah'** (Yeshayahu 56:7)."** The cascade is exact: tefillah (**beis Hashem**) → ma'yan (chochmah) → gan (Torah) → grasses (Israel's souls). And **"tefillah is the aspect of **bringing from potentia to actuality** — because tefillah is the aspect of renewal of the world: tefillah is that he believes there is a **mechadesh** in Whose hand is to act as He wishes, to change..."**

intermediate.en: **Tikunei Zohar (14, 29b): "Gan da oraysa"** = Torah. Souls of Israel = **grasses growing in the gan** from a **ma'yan = chochmah** ("ma'yan ganim," Shir 4:15). Ma'yan itself flows from **tefillah** ("u'ma'yan m'beis Hashem yetzei," Yoel 4:18; "ki beisi beis tefillah," Yesh 56:7). **Cascade**: tefillah → ma'yan (chochmah) → gan (Torah) → grasses (souls of Israel). Tefillah = bringing potentia to actuality = renewal (requires emunah in a **mechadesh**).
intermediate.he: **תיקוני זוהר (תיקון יד, כט:): "גן דא אורייתא"** = תורה. נשמות ישראל = **עשבים ודשאים הגדלים בגן** מ**מעין = חכמה** ("מעיין גנים", שה"ש ד, טו). המעיין זורם מה**תפילה** ("ומעין מבית ה' יצא", יואל ד, יח; "כי ביתי בית תפילה", יש' נו, ז). **מפל**: תפילה → מעיין (חכמה) → גן (תורה) → דשאים (נשמות). תפילה = הוצאה מכח אל הפועל = חידוש (בתנאי אמונה ב**מחדש**).

scholarly.he: סעיף ז. תק"ז י"ד כט: "גן דא אורייתא". נשמות ישראל כדשאים; מעיין=חכמה (שה"ש ד, טו); מעיין מהתפילה (יואל ד, יח; יש' נו, ז).

beginner.en: **"And this is: **'v'nahar yotze me'Eden l'hashkos es ha'gan, u'misham yipared v'hayah l'arba'a rashim'** (Bereshis 2:10) — 'a river goes out from Eden to water the garden, and from there it separates and becomes four heads.'"** The Rebbe decodes: **"**Eden** is the aspect of **tefillah** — because Eden is **'ayin lo ra'asa'** — 'no eye has seen' — as Chazal said (Berachos 34b) — and this is the aspect of tefillah, which is above nature, because by tefillah one changes nature, as above. [This is Eden, 'ayin lo ra'asa' — because above nature we have no grasp.]"** And: **"'V'nahar yotze me'Eden'** — from tefillah — as above, **'u'ma'yan m'beis Hashem yetzei'**. **'L'hashkos es ha'gan'** — this is Torah, as above, **'ma'yan ganim'**. And when the **spring of chochmah** is drawn from tefillah into the gan (Torah), then **'ismarbiyun eshavin v'deshain'** — grasses and herbs multiply — the **souls of Israel** grow."**

intermediate.en: **"V'nahar yotze me'Eden l'hashkos es ha'gan, u'misham yipared v'hayah l'arba'a rashim"** (Ber 2:10): **Eden = tefillah** ("ayin lo ra'asa," Berachos 34b — above nature, where we have no grasp). **River = from tefillah** (Yoel 4:18); **waters garden** = Torah (Shir 4:15); and **grasses/herbs multiply** = souls of Israel grow.
intermediate.he: **"ונהר יוצא מעדן להשקות את הגן, ומשם יפרד והיה לארבעה ראשים"** (בר' ב, י): **עדן = תפילה** ("עין לא ראתה", ברכ' לד: — למעלה מהטבע, אין לנו בו תפיסה). **הנהר מהתפילה** (יואל ד, יח); **משקה את הגן** = תורה (שה"ש ד, טו); ו**עשבים ודשאים מתרבים** = נשמות ישראל גדלות.

scholarly.he: בר' ב, י: עדן = תפילה (ברכ' לד.: "עין לא ראתה"); הנהר מהתפילה; הגן — תורה; הדשאים — נשמות ישראל.

beginner.en: **"This is the aspect of four **tzitzis** — because the four tzitzis are the aspect of **ruach chayim**, as it is written: **'koh amar Hashem: me'arba ruchos bo'i ha'ruach'** (Yechezkel 37:9) — 'thus says Hashem: from the four winds come, O spirit.'"** The tzitzis corner-fringes are literally the four-directional receiver-antennae for ruach chayim. **"By this one subdues the **ruach se'arah** — which is the ruach of the **misnagedim** who dispute the true tzaddikim, and draw their lengthened-ruach from the **rav d'klipah** — the aspect of **Esav ish sa'ir** as above."** Therefore: **"Tzitzis is lashon **sei'ar** (hair) — as it is written: **'vayikacheni b'tzitzis roshi'** (Yechezkel 8:3) — 'He took me by the tzitzis of my head' (by my forelock) — because by these [tzitzis] **Esav ish sa'ir** is subdued — aspect of ruach se'arah as above."** And: **"This is the aspect of the **tallis lavan** in which Hashem wrapped Himself when teaching the 13 middos"** (Rosh Hashanah 17b) — because the **13 middos** [are the 13 channels by which the long ruach of Hashem is drawn through a tallis of white threads to Jewish lacks].

intermediate.en: **Four tzitzis = four winds of ruach chayim** ("me'arba ruchos bo'i ha'ruach," Yech 37:9) — four-directional antennae. Subdues the **ruach se'arah of misnagedim** who draw from **rav d'klipah = Esav ish sa'ir**. Tzitzis = **sei'ar** (hair) ("vayikacheni b'tzitzis roshi," Yech 8:3) — subdues Esav ish sa'ir. **Tallis lavan** of the 13 middos (RH 17b): the 13 channels through which Hashem's long ruach is drawn to Jewish lacks.
intermediate.he: **ד' ציציות = ד' רוחות רוח חיים** ("מארבע רוחות בואי הרוח", יחז' לז, ט) — אנטנות ד'־כיווניות. מכניעות את **רוח סערה של המתנגדים** היונקים מ**רב דקליפה = עשו איש שעיר**. ציצית = **שיער** ("ויקחני בציצית ראשי", יחז' ח, ג) — מכניע עשו איש שעיר. **טלית לבן** של י"ג מידות (ר"ה יז:): י"ג צינורות שבהם רוח ה' הארוכה נמשכת לחסרונות ישראל.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. ד' ציציות = ד' רוחות רוח חיים (יחז' לז, ט); מכניעות רוח סערה (מנגדים מרב־קליפה); ציצית=שיער (יחז' ח, ג); טלית לבן וי"ג מידות (ר"ה יז:).

beginner.en: **"V'zeh peirush:"** — and here comes the sixth Rabba bar bar Chana ma'amar (following akrukta, worm-in-fish, ship-between-fins, geese, Sinai with scorpions). **"Amar Rabba bar bar Chana: said to me a certain Arab: 'Come and I will show you the **meisei midbar** (dead of the wilderness).' I went and saw them, and they looked **like men drunk** (*k'man d'm'vasmei*), lying **al p'raqid** (on their backs), and **the knee of one of them was raised** — and the Arab entered under that knee, while riding a camel and holding his spear upright, and it did not touch [the knee]. **I cut off one corner of **techeles** from one of them — and we could no longer move.** He said to me: 'Perhaps you took something from them? For we have a tradition — whoever takes anything from them, he cannot move.' I went and returned it, and again we could move."** (Bava Basra 74a). Every detail — the Arab guide, the drunk-appearing corpses, the raised knee, the spear that won't touch, the techeles corner, the traveler's paralysis — will be decoded.

intermediate.en: Sixth Rabba bar bar Chana ma'amar (after akrukta, worm-fish, ship-fins, geese, Sinai): **"An Arab: come, I'll show you the meisei midbar. I saw them like drunk men, lying on their backs, one's knee raised; the Arab rode a camel under the knee with spear upright, didn't touch. I cut one corner of techeles from one — we couldn't move. He said: 'Perhaps you took something? Tradition: anyone who takes from them can't move.' I returned it, we could move"** (Bava Basra 74a).
intermediate.he: המאמר השישי של רבב"ח (אחר אקרוקתא, שרץ, ספינה, אווזים, סיני): **"אמר לי ההוא טייעא: תא אחוי לך מתי מדבר. אזלי וחזיתינהו, ודמו כמאן דמבסמי, וגנו אפרקיד; והווה זקיפא ברכה דחד מינייהו; ועייל טייעא תותה ברכה כי רכיב גמלא וזקיפא רמחיה ולא נגע בה. פסקי חדא קרנא דתכלתא דחד מינייהו, ולא הוה מסתגי לן. אמר לי: דלמא שקלת מידי מינייהו? דגמירי, דמאן דשקיל מידי מינייהו לא מסתגי לה. אזלי אהדרתה, והדר מסתגי לן"** (ב"ב עד.).

scholarly.he: ב"ב עד.: המאמר השישי — טייעא, מתי מדבר, כמבוסמין, פרקיד, ברכה זקופה, רמחא, קרנא דתכלתא, מסתגי לן.

beginner.en: **Rashbam's gloss**: **"**Taya** = Ishmaelite merchant. **Azali v'chazisinhu v'dmu k'man d'm'vasmei** = they were lying with yellow faces like wine-drinkers. **A'p'raqid** = faces upward. **V'ayil taya'a tuseh bircha** = I saw the merchant passing under the knee of the dead man, riding on the camel with his spear in hand, and it didn't touch the knee. **Shakla chada karna** = the corner of the tallis to show to the sages, to derive from it the law of tzitzis — whether like Beis Shammai or Beis Hillel (as below). **V'lo hava ka'mistagi lan** = the animals we were riding on could not move."**

intermediate.en: Rashbam: **taya** = Ishmaelite merchant; **kvasamei** = yellow-faced like drunks; **a'p'raqid** = faces up; **tuseh bircha** = under the raised knee (Arab on camel, spear up); **shakla chada karna** = a corner of the tallis — to show sages & derive tzitzis law (Beis Shammai vs Hillel); **lo mistagi** = our mounts couldn't move.
intermediate.he: רשב"ם: **טייעא** = סוחר ישמעאלי; **כמבוסמי** = פנים צהובות ככשתויי יין; **אפרקיד** = פנים למעלה; **תותה ברכה** = תחת ברך זקופה (טייעא רוכב גמלא, רמחו זקוף); **שקלא חדא קרנא** = כנף הטלית — להראות לחכמים ולדון דין ציצית (ב"ש/ב"ה); **לא מסתגי** = הבהמות שרכבנו לא יכלו לנוע.

scholarly.he: רשב"ם: טייעא—סוחר; כמבוסמי—כשתויי יין; אפרקיד—פנים למעלה; תותה ברכה—תחת הברך; קרנא—כנף טלית לדין ציצית; לא מסתגי—הבהמות לא זזו.

beginner.en: The Rebbe's interpretation. **"'Ta v'achavei lach meisei midbar'** — he showed him the **reshaim who are not attached to tzaddikim** — and they are called 'meisei midbar' because **the midbar — no north-wind blew in it** (Yevamos 72a) — this is the aspect of **ruach chayim d'kedushah**, the aspect of the **ruach tzefonis** that blew through **David's kinnor**, as above. These reshaim, who are not attached to tzaddikim and have no ruach d'kedushah — **in their lifetime they are called dead**."** **"And he showed him **from where the completion of their lack reaches them**. And this is what he showed him: **'dhavu dmu k'mvasamei'** — Rashi: as wine-drinkers — the aspect of **Esav ha'admoni** (the ruddy one), who is the **rav d'klipah** from whom the reshaim receive *their* ruach chayim to complete their lack. And **'v'ganu a'p'raqid'** — with face upward — [the hint to their upward posture toward the klipah-rav, opposite the tzaddik's downward flow of ruach]."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **"Meisei midbar"** = reshaim **not attached to tzaddikim** — midbar (wilderness) = no north-wind = no **ruach chayim d'kedushah** (Yevamos 72a; David's kinnor played by ruach tzefonis). In life they are called dead. **K'mvasamei** = drunk on wine = **Esav ha'admoni = rav d'klipah** from whom they receive their ruach. **A'p'raqid** (face upward) = their posture toward the klipah-rav.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **"מתי מדבר"** = רשעים **שאינם דבוקים בצדיקים** — מדבר = לא נושבת בו רוח צפונית = אין **רוח חיים דקדושה** (יבמות עב.; כינור דוד ברוח צפונית). בחייהם קרויים מתים. **כמבוסמי** = כשתויי יין = **עשו האדמוני = רב דקליפה** ממנו יונקים רוחם. **אפרקיד** (פנים למעלה) = תנוחתם כלפי הרב־קליפה.

scholarly.he: פירוש: מתי מדבר—רשעים שאינם דבוקים בצדיקים (אין רוח צפונית, יבמות עב.); כמבוסמי—עשו האדמוני (רב־קליפה); אפרקיד—פנייה לרב־קליפה.

beginner.en: **"And behold, as explained above, ruach chayim is in Torah — aspect of 'v'ruach Elokim merachefes.' Therefore in Mitzrayim, which was **before** the receiving of Torah, they had nowhere to receive ruach chayim from, it is said of them: **'mi'kotzer ruach'** (Shemos 6:9) — 'from shortness of breath'** — because they had nowhere to receive ruach chayim, which is the aspect of **erech apayim** (long breath/patience), ma'arich ruchah, as above. Therefore it says of them 'mi'kotzer ruach' — the opposite of erech apayim — which is the aspect of ruach chayim that one draws by means of a sigh to complete the lack."** **"This is the aspect of **'v'yiten lecha mish'alos libecha'** — 'May He give you the requests of your heart.' And this is the aspect of **'harchev picha va'amal'eihu'** (Tehillim 81:11) — 'open your mouth wide and I will fill it' — that the lack is filled."** And the Rebbe's sharp wordplay: **"This is the aspect of **mela'um** (the melopum vowel) — **malei pum** (full mouth) — the matter: mela'um is **vav with shuruk** — and it is the aspect of **10 kinds of pulse** against..."**

intermediate.en: **Mitzrayim = before Torah = no source of ruach chayim** → "mi'kotzer ruach" (Shem 6:9) — opposite of **erech apayim** (long patient ruach). Ruach chayim drawn by sigh completes the lack ("v'yiten lecha mish'alos libecha"; **"harchev picha va'amal'eihu,"** Teh 81:11). Wordplay: **mela'um** (melopum vowel = full-mouth vav-with-shuruk) = **malei pum** = 10 kinds of pulse.
intermediate.he: **מצרים = קודם התורה = אין מקור לרוח חיים** → "מקוצר רוח" (שמ' ו, ט) — היפך **ארך אפיים** (רוח ארוכה וסבלנית). רוח חיים הנמשכת בקרעכץ משלימה החיסרון ("ויתן לך משאלות ליבך"; **"הרחב פיך ואמלאהו",** תה' פא, יא). משחק־לשון: **מלאפום** (ניקוד מלא־פום = וא"ו עם שורוק) = **מלא־פום** = י' מיני דופק.

scholarly.he: סעיף ט. מצרים קודם מתן־תורה—"מקוצר רוח" (שמ' ו, ט), היפך ארך אפיים. "הרחב פיך ואמלאהו" (תה' פא, יא). מלאפום = מלא־פה.

beginner.en: **"'Rechev Elokim ribosayim, alfei shinan'"** (Tehillim 68:18) — 'the chariot of G-d is twice ten thousand, thousands of angels.' **"'Alfei' = aspect of **alufei Esav**; and by 'rechev Elokim ribosayim' — the aspect of **kabbalas ha'Torah**, where the **rabbanim d'kedushah** receive the ruach chayim — by this 'alfei shinan' — as Chazal expounded (Avodah Zarah 3b): **'al tikri shinan ella she'einan'** — 'do not read *shinan* but *she'einan* (that are not).'"** Meaning: **"By receiving the Torah — where the ruach of the rav d'kedushah is — by this are nullified and subdued the **alufei Esav, rabrevei Esav**, who are the aspect of rav d'klipah — in the aspect of **'alfei she'einan'** — the alufei Esav, the rabrevei Esav, are nullified and are not."**

intermediate.en: **"Rechev Elokim ribosayim, alfei shinan"** (Teh 68:18): **alfei** = **alufei Esav**; **rechev Elokim ribosayim** = **kabbalas ha'Torah** where rabbanim d'kedushah receive ruach chayim. Then **"al tikri *shinan* ella *she'einan*"** (AZ 3b) = the alufei/rabrevei Esav (rav d'klipah) are nullified, "are not."
intermediate.he: **"רכב אלהים ריבותיים, אלפי שנאן"** (תה' סח, יח): **אלפי** = **אלופי עשו**; **רכב אלהים ריבותיים** = **קבלת התורה** שבה רבני דקדושה מקבלים רוח חיים. ואז **"אל תקרי *שנאן* אלא *שאינן*"** (ע"ז ג:) = אלופי/רברבי עשו (רב דקליפה) בטלים, "שאינם".

scholarly.he: "רכב אלהים ריבותיים אלפי שנאן" (תה' סח, יח): אלפי=אלופי עשו; שנאן=שאינן (ע"ז ג:) — אלופי עשו מתבטלים בקבלת התורה.

beginner.en: **"'Mi'knaf ha'aretz zemiros shama'anu, tzvi latzaddik; v'omar: razi li razi li, oy li, **bogedim bagadu, u'beged bogdim bagadu'"** (Yeshayahu 24:16). **"'Mi'knaf ha'aretz'** — this is the aspect of the **knafei ha'tzitzis**, where the ruach chayim is — the aspect of **David's kinnor**, which played by ruach tzefonis, as above (see Zohar Shelach 175b) — because **neginah and zemiros are drawn from the ruach chayim in the lungs** (*b'kanfei rei'ah*), as is known."** **"And this is: **'zemiros shama'anu'** — the aspect of the tune of David's kinnor — which is the aspect of **ruach chayim** — which is the aspect of **knafei ha'tzitzis** — aspect of **mi'knaf ha'aretz**. By this one subdues the reshaim, in the aspect of **'le'echoz b'kanfos ha'aretz v'yina'aru reshaim mimenah'** (Iyov 38:13)."** The Torah that opened with the krechtz of a Jew closes with the four-winged kinnor-music of David, sung from the four-cornered tzitzis — the very sound by which the world shakes the resha'im off its wings at the coming of Mashiach, announced in the Haftarah of Shabbos Chanukah.

intermediate.en: **"Mi'knaf ha'aretz zemiros shama'anu, tzvi latzaddik"** (Yesh 24:16). **Mi'knaf ha'aretz** = **knafei ha'tzitzis** = seat of ruach chayim = David's kinnor (played by ruach tzefonis; Zohar Shelach 175b; zemiros drawn from ruach chayim in the **kanfei rei'ah**/lungs). **"Zemiros shama'anu"** = David's kinnor-tune = ruach chayim of tzitzis = mi'knaf ha'aretz. Subdues reshaim — **"le'echoz b'kanfos ha'aretz v'yina'aru reshaim mimenah"** (Iyov 38:13). The Torah closes: the krechtz that opened it is the same ruach that ends as the kinnor-song shaking resha'im off the earth's wings at Mashiach.
intermediate.he: **"מכנף הארץ זמירות שמענו, צבי לצדיק"** (יש' כד, טז). **מכנף הארץ** = **כנפי הציצית** = מושב רוח חיים = כינור דוד (רוח צפונית; זוהר שלח קעה.; זמירות נמשכות מרוח חיים ב**כנפי הריאה**). **"זמירות שמענו"** = ניגון כינור דוד = רוח חיים של ציצית = מכנף הארץ. מכניע רשעים — **"לאחוז בכנפות הארץ וינערו רשעים ממנה"** (איוב לח, יג). התורה חותמת: הקרעכץ שפתח אותה היא אותה רוח שבסופה ניגון־הכינור ינער את הרשעים מכנפי הארץ בביאת המשיח.

scholarly.he: "מכנף הארץ זמירות שמענו צבי לצדיק" (יש' כד, טז). מכנף הארץ=כנפי ציצית=רוח חיים=כינור דוד (זוהר שלח קעה.; כנפי הריאה). ינער רשעים (איוב לח, יג).
